correctness.rationale: The proof explicitly derives complementary closed-neighborhood own-color fractions after cross-part swaps, showing old utility levels are exchanged, and handles within-part swaps by identical external neighborhoods. On bicliques the four color/part classes give the stated generating polynomial with binomial multiplicities; all corner cases and the exact global min/max follow by a boundary/interior case partition, including singleton parts and minority count one. The embedded standalone verifier checks 85 full multipartite structure families and 184 biclique parameter cases by exact arithmetic. Tests supplement the all-size proof.

value.rationale: The integration measure is a central social welfare objective of the initiating model. The exact full multiplicity distribution over every stable biclique coloring answers a natural complete classification not provided by existential equilibrium and generic welfare bounds. It yields exact PoS=1 while PoA grows linearly on \(K_{2,t}\) with k=2, a motivated robustness-versus-diversity separation, and all conclusions hold for arbitrary part sizes without restricting to arbitrary finite cutoffs.
